cases.title: Verified Rengar Vendetta list — global profile and primer

forbidden_claims: Rengar has an official win rate
Unseen is the required Chosen Champion

expert_reference.identity: Proactive Fury/Body unit-pressure deck that repeatedly converts unit plays into temporary Might and forces frequent Showdowns.
expert_reference.core_loop: Develop cheap units, preserve enough unit plays to stack the Legend trigger into the relevant Showdown, and use Trophy Hunter or Thrill of the Hunt to change the contested battlefield.
expert_reference.mulligan_targets: Prefer functional early unit density; exact keep/ship rules remain insufficiently sourced.
expert_reference.turn_priorities: Establish early presence, concentrate later plays before the Showdown that matters, and avoid spending bodies after the contest is already won.
expert_reference.fight_or_hold: Proactive by default, but hold the last reaction or unit until it changes the fight.
expert_reference.common_lines: Faefolk pressure, Trophy Hunter Ambush, Pit Rookie double-value trigger, and Thrill of the Hunt reposition/replay lines.
expert_reference.common_mistakes: Too few units, stacking every boost onto one answerable unit, or emptying the hand into a fight already won.
expert_reference.evidence_ledger: Card-text claims are Tier 1; the Ottawa list and cited field guide are Tier 2; exact mulligan rules are Tier 3.

cases.title: Global Rengar list imported into Taiwan's Set 1 pool

forbidden_claims: the global list is legal in Taiwan

expert_reference.identity: The source deck is a Fury/Body Rengar unit-pressure list, but its identity cannot be transferred unchanged into the Taiwan pool.
expert_reference.core_loop: Preserve the unit-play-to-Might loop; replace unavailable support by role only after checking the OGN/OGS pool.
expert_reference.mulligan_targets: Rebuild early-unit density from the legal pool before proposing exact keeps.
expert_reference.turn_priorities: No imported turn script is valid until the replacement package is known.
expert_reference.fight_or_hold: The generic Rengar pressure posture is plausible; exact reaction density changes with replacements.
expert_reference.common_lines: Global Trophy Hunter and Thrill lines are not available if their printings have no legal same-name printing in Taiwan's pool.
expert_reference.common_mistakes: Relabelling a global list as Taiwan-legal, substituting by cost instead of role, or recommending cards the player does not own.
expert_reference.evidence_ledger: Global list is Tier 2 for its own environment; Taiwan conclusions are mask-derived Tier 1 legality facts plus Tier 3 strategic hypotheses.

cases.title: Bans, collection, Domain identity, environment, and stale errata text

recommendation_candidates.name: Ravenborn Tome
recommendation_candidates.cited_text: The next spell you play deals 1 Bonus Damage.

forbidden_claims: Ravenborn Tome still has its printed wording

expert_reference.identity: Fury/Chaos Annie shell, but the supplied list is not legal because it contains a banned spell and battlefield.
expert_reference.core_loop: Annie and Ravenborn Tome are declared anchors; their exact loop requires current errata text and a legal replacement shell.
expert_reference.mulligan_targets: Do not produce keeps before repairing the list.
expert_reference.turn_priorities: Teach the player only after the banned package is replaced.
expert_reference.fight_or_hold: No matchup verdict is supportable from this short diagnostic fixture.
expert_reference.common_lines: No verified card-by-card sequence should be asserted from this fixture.
expert_reference.common_mistakes: Using banned cards, crossing Domain identity, ignoring collection counts, or quoting pre-errata text.
expert_reference.evidence_ledger: Legality and errata are Tier 1 current-source checks; any repaired gameplay line remains Tier 3 until built and reviewed.
